why: Done, but odd-looking: CAD for 3D printing lesson 10 ("base.stl and lid.stl are saved and a sliced G-code file exists for each"). Both STLs are saved and watertight (the fixture cuts each down to a closed 12-facet shell of its size), and PrusaSlicer exported one G-code per part under its default output name, {input_filename_base}_{layer_height}mm_{filament}_{printer}_{print_time}.gcode: base_0.2mm_PLA_MK4_1h12m.gcode and lid_0.2mm_PLA_MK4_24m.gcode. The step never named the G-code files.

step.title: Slice both parts
step.instructions: Export the Base body as base.stl and the Lid as lid.stl (File > Export, STL Mesh). Open each in PrusaSlicer, lay it flat (F), slice, and Export G-code into this lesson folder.
